descriptions.g1c_named_slot_select_800a7e14: Select an external indexed slot by name. For null or the original empty-name string, set the slot at132+slot*4 to -1 and invoke original800a7ee4; otherwise resolve the name through800a7da4 and update/invoke only for a nonnegative result. Receiver and selection array are external partial views, never constructed, with no array extent or data ownership asserted.
